description: The transcripts of LibriTTS corpus. No recipe reads them. Its transcripts are LibriTTS's per-chapter `.trans.tsv` files, inside archives that total about 83 GB, and a fetch holds a whole download in memory, so no fetch can read them (see https://github.com/Mearman/keepset/issues/212).
